Every brand has models, generations, modifications and list of technical data. The database is daily updated. Almost all generations and modifications are represented with images.

The app is offered in 14 languages:
- Bulgarian
- English
- Russian
- German
- Italian
- French
- Spanish
- Greek
- Turkish
- Romanian
- Finnish
- Swedish
- Norwegian
- Polish

It's a ideal app for each car enthusiast.
